briefing: Markets are in risk-on mode with NASDAQ +1.8% and S&P 500 +1.6%, so we deployed idle cash into our three open slots. Picked GOOGL for its full set of bullish technical signals, plus ASST and ZG for diversification with healthy but less overbought momentum.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only acting on a trade when several independent indicators — like RSI, MACD, price vs. moving average, and volume — all point the same direction at once. A single bullish signal can be noise, but when four or five line up together, it suggests real institutional buying rather than a random price blip.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重訊號確認是指只有當多個獨立指標（例如RSI、MACD、股價與移動平均線的關係、以及成交量）同時指向同一方向時，才採取交易行動。單一個看漲訊號可能只是噪音，但當四、五個訊號同時出現時，往往代表的是真實的機構買盤，而非偶然的價格波動。

market_education.summary_en: Broad gains across the Nasdaq (+1.8%) and S&P 500 (+1.6%) today reflect continued investor confidence in growth and technology names, with healthy market breadth rather than a narrow mega-cap rally. No negative catalysts emerged to disrupt the bullish technical setups building across many stocks. This kind of broad participation across sectors is typically viewed as a healthier signal than a rally concentrated in just a few names.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日納斯達克指數上漲1.8%，標普500指數上漲1.6%，反映投資者對成長股及科技股的信心持續升溫，而且這次上漲的廣度良好，並非單靠少數大型股撐起。市場沒有出現重大負面消息，讓許多股票的技術面多頭格局得以延續。這種跨板塊的普遍參與通常被視為比僅集中在少數股票上的升勢更健康的訊號。
